title: The Letters Continued
subtitle: The Circleville Letter Writer · Ohio, 1976–1994
voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.
grade: Desaturated documentary still, small-town rural Ohio in the late 1970s and 1980s, flat farmland horizon, wood-frame houses with screen doors, dim yellowish kitchens, country roads, melancholy and uncanny, period 1976-1994 detail, cinematic wide composition, fine film grain, no text, no signage, no people, no faces.

beats.vo: For almost twenty years, beginning in nineteen seventy-six, someone in Circleville, Ohio, sent anonymous letters to dozens of residents.
beats.img: A rural American country mailbox at the end of a gravel driveway on a flat Ohio farmland road, late afternoon summer light, distant wood-frame farmhouse, melancholy, no people.

beats.vo: Handwritten. Specific. The writer knew what people had done. And what they had not.
beats.img: Several handwritten letters in printed block capitals scattered on a worn kitchen table under dim yellow overhead light, indistinct text, eerie, no people, no readable content.

beats.vo: In nineteen seventy-seven, a small handgun was rigged to a mailbox. It was meant for Mary Gilligan.
beats.cap:
A trap
rigged to a mailbox
beats.img: An old rural metal mailbox at the end of a wooden post seen close at dusk, door slightly ajar, dim evening light on flat Ohio farmland behind, sinister, no people.

beats.vo: Her brother-in-law was convicted. He maintained his innocence. The letters continued while he was in prison.
beats.img: A bare institutional prison cell window seen from outside, dim evening light, blue-grey uniform wall, cold fluorescent glow, melancholy and isolating, no people.

beats.vo: He served ten years. The case was never solved.
beats.img: An empty flat Ohio farmland road at dusk stretching to the horizon, weathered wood fence posts, hazy fading light over farm fields, remote and unresolved, no people.
